forecastReasoning.narrative:
Classic Dryline Cyclone governs the 12Z Day 1–12Z Day 2 period. The 12Z Day 1 issuance carries a ENH maximum, with Slight-or-greater probabilities covering 35% of the domain. The primary corridor peaks near 12Z Day 1, when mean initiation reaches 7% and expected storm coverage reaches 2%.

A lee cyclone, sharpening dryline, and elevated mixed layer organize the warm sector while ascent approaches from the west. A representative corridor sounding contains about 4530 J/kg CAPE, 476 m²/s² SRH, 89 kt deep-layer shear, 1845 m LCLs, STP 10.8, and VTP 3.4. Flow increases from roughly 30 kt at 850 mb to 68 kt at 500 mb and 77 kt at 250 mb.

Maximum probabilities are 10% tornado, 15% hail, and 0% wind; large hail is the leading hazard signal. The analog ensemble has high agreement (94% confidence; 30 members), with mean moisture return 86%, clearing 85%, forcing 76%, and cap persistence 65%. No ensemble failure mode exceeds the reporting threshold.
supportingFactors: Coherent synoptic pattern and frontal geometry (95%)
Strong low-level hodograph curvature (476 m²/s² SRH)
Storm mode and conditional intensity support tornado potential
limitingFactors: Low or highly localized initiation signal (7% corridor mean)
Sparse expected storm coverage (2% corridor mean)
